title: lathyrus laevigatus subsp. hispanicus
intro: Lathyrus laevigatus subsp. hispanicus, commonly known as Spanish pea or smooth pea, is a perennial legume plant native to the Iberian Peninsula. This plant is rich in health benefits, particularly for its high content of protein, fiber, and various minerals, which can help to support digestive health, lower cholesterol levels, and manage blood sugar levels. The therapeutic actions of Lathyrus laevigatus subsp. hispanicus include its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, making it useful in treating various health conditions such as arthritis, diabetes, and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential to inhibit the growth of cancer cells and improve cardiovascular health.
